summary: You can now save the pictures, videos and files people send you.
changes: Clicking a file or the download button of an attachment saves it, instead of doing nothing.
Right-click an image or a video to save it in its original size, copy it or copy its link. Links can be opened in your browser or copied.
improvements: Text fields have a right-click menu with cut, copy and paste.
Images are saved from the original file, not the resized preview shown in the chat.
fixes: Files sent in Discord could not be downloaded in ZERO, on Windows and on Linux.
